mission.heading: THE ETERNAL TIMELINE
paras: Marrowfen sits above caves older than the town. Every thirty-three years one child vanishes, and within a week nobody remembers them.
Last night it was Noel, your little brother. Only you remember. His watch still ticks, backwards.
You are Ilan. Tess is with you. Follow the watch underground, find who keeps tying the loop, and cut it before ten minutes run out.

voice.t: Marrowfen sits above caves older than the town. Every thirty-three years one child vanishes, and within a week nobody remembers them. Last night it was Noel, your little brother. Only you remember. His watch still ticks, backwards. You are Ilan. Tess is with you. Follow the watch underground, find who keeps tying the loop, and cut it before ten minutes run out.

tutorial.title: Threads, hints and the clock
tutorial.text: You earn Threads for items and for finishing rooms. Wrong answers cost 10. You have 3 hints, 25 Threads each. You have 10:00. The clock keeps running while a hint is spoken.

opening.t: November. Rain falls on the iron gate at the back of the caves.
Noel's watch lies on the stone. Its hands run backwards.
He was here. Ten minutes ago, or ten years.
Then we find him before the watch runs out.
Why do you remember him, Tess? Nobody else does.
Ask me later. There's a lantern by the wall. Start there.

ring.name: Brass ring
ring.desc: The missing inner ring of a stone wheel.

people.name: Ilan Verrow, 18
people.text: You. Noel's big brother. You are the only one who remembers him.

people.name: Tess Calder, 17
people.text: Red wool scarf, green coat. She remembers things she should not know.

people.name: Noel Verrow, 9
people.text: Your little brother. He vanished at the Cave Gate. His watch still ticks backwards.

people.name: A. Holt, night warden
people.text: A name in every log. An old woman in a red scarf, who never ages. Always at the Gate.

r1_bars.title: Red wool
r1_bars.text: Red wool is snagged on the Gate bars, as if someone pulled hard.

page1.title: The Carved Years (Page 1)
page1.text: Carved into the wall: 1920. 1953. 19_6 (scraped). A tablet above the Gate: EVERY 33 WINTERS.

page2.title: Night Warden's Card (Page 2)
page2.text: "Drum turns ANTI-CLOCKWISE to raise the cage. Motor gear 12 teeth, turns clockwise. Drum gear 24 teeth. A gear is as wide as its teeth. Shaft gap, centre to centre: 54. A. Holt, night warden, 1953." A second line in the same hand, dated 1986, repeats the rule.

r2_log.title: Night log
r2_log.text: Entries in 1953 and 1986. Same handwriting, same name: A. Holt.

page3.title: The Missing Ledger (Page 3)
page3.text: Three night ledgers, 1953, 1986 and 2019, each with five cards about who was where.

r4_note.title: Darkroom note
r4_note.text: "Red glass shows the digit. Green glass shows its place. Read the code from place 1 to place 3."

r4_prints.title: The photographs
r4_prints.text: Three prints of the Gate, 1953, 1986, 2019. The same woman, about seventy, in a red scarf. On her wrist: Noel's brass watch.

page4.title: Developed Prints (Page 4)
page4.text: The woman at the Gate never ages. Red scarf. Noel's watch.

page5.title: The Bell Plaque (Page 5)
page5.text: "The Chapel bell tolled for 1953. The station whistle sounded for 1986. The Gate lamp burned for 2019. A.H. rang for them all. Set them in the order they fell."

r6_grave.title: Gravestone
r6_grave.text: ADA HOLT. WARDEN OF THE GATE. No date of death.

r6_wall.title: Wall inscription
r6_wall.text: BEGIN THE WHEEL AT THE GATE. A STANDS UNDER THE GATE'S FIRST LETTER.

page7.title: The Keeper's Last Page (Page 7)
page7.text: Every rescue ties the next knot.

Or a hundred years ago. Safe's got three digits.

right.t: H, O, L, T. Holt is Tess.
Yes.
You were at that Gate in 1953. In 1986. In 2019.
Every time I tried to save him, I made it worse. I'm sorry, Ilan.
There's one door left. Come on.
The crypt stair turns down toward a room with no walls.

rooms.name: The Knot
rooms.objective: Move the rings. Answer the Keeper.

enter.t: There are no walls. Only threads.
This is the Knot. Don't pull on anything.
Seventeen. I was seventeen the first time I stood here.
I am what she becomes. I have tied this knot four times. Move the rings. Show me you understand.

torch.title: The Carved Wall
torch.tip: Drag the light across the wall. Tap each carving to read it.

discuss.t: Somebody keeps it. Or it keeps us.

r1_dial.title: The Little Door
r1_dial.label: The last year the Gate took a child, before this winter.

wrong.t: Look at the gaps between the years. Always the same?
Count the winters between 1920 and 1953. The tablet helps.
Thirty-three each time. Add it to 1953.

hint.t: Fill the scraped year from the pattern. The tablet gives the gap.

gears.title: Gear Train
gears.tip: Tap gears to build a train from the motor to the drum. Then press Test.

labels.tooShort: The train is too short. There is a gap.
labels.tooLong: The train is too long. It will not fit.
labels.wrongWay: It fits, but the drum turns the wrong way.
labels.works: It fits. The drum turns anticlockwise.

wrong.t: The gap is fixed. What do the middle gears have to add up to?
A gear is as wide as its teeth. Half of each end gear counts.
The middle gears must total 36, and the drum must turn the other way.

hint.t: Two middle gears. They add up to 36.

grid.title: Alibi Grid
grid.tip: Tap a box to tick it, tap again to cross it out. One person per place.

labels.final: Who was at the Cave Gate on all three nights?

wrongGrid.t: Start with the "neither" cards. Cross out what each person can't be.
Find a place only one person could be. Fill that first.
Once a place is fixed, cross it out for everyone else.

wrongFinal.t: Compare the three grids. Who changes places?
The three family names move around. One name doesn't.
The one who was never anywhere but the Gate.

hint.t: Begin with the place only one person can reach.

lens.title: Tinted Lenses
lens.tip: Drag a lens over a photo. Use both lenses on every photo.

labels.done: Every photo is read. Now the safe.
labels.lensHome: Drag a lens onto a photo

r4_safe.title: The Safe
r4_safe.label: Three digits. Read the code from place 1 to place 3.

wrong.t: Try both glasses on every print. They show different things.
Red gives the digit. Green says where it goes. The dates are a trap.
Put the digits in green's order, not in date order.

hint.t: Read green's number, then red's digit. Order by green.

sight.title: Town View
sight.tip: Turn to find the landmarks named on the plaque. Put one under the wire, then press Read.

hint.t: Chapel spire, station stack, Gate lamp. Read each numeral off the ring.

r5_box.title: The Bell Box
r5_box.label: Three numerals, in the order the years fell.
r5_box.symbols: I II III IV V VI VII VIII IX X XI XII

wrong.t: Line the landmark up with the wire, then read the ring.
The plaque names three landmarks. Ignore the silo and the tank.
Chapel first, then the station, then the Gate lamp.

hint.t: Chapel spire, station stack, Gate lamp. Read each numeral off the ring.

cipher.title: The Cipher Wheel
cipher.tip: Turn the inner ring. Then press Read.

wrong.t: The wall says where the wheel begins.
Begin at the Gate. Which letter does "Gate" start with?
Put A under the Gate's first letter, then read the carved words.

hint.t: Set A beneath G. Then press Read.

knot.title: The Knot
knot.tip: Move all 3 rings to After. One at a time. A bigger ring never sits on a smaller one.

labels.selected: Pick a post to drop it on.

illegal.t: A larger year can't rest on a smaller one.
Move the 2019 ring out of the way first.
Think of a stack. Take the top one, one at a time.

slow.t: Slow down. The smallest ring moves every other turn.

hint1.t: Move the smallest ring to the middle post. Then the only other legal move. Repeat.

part1Right.t: The last ring settles. The knot overhead loosens a little.
Good. Now the question I ask every time.

ask.t: Why can he not come back?

question.title: The Keeper's Question
question.text: Why can he not come back?

options.t: The Gate takes one child every 33 years and nothing can change that.
Every rescue ties the next loss. The rescuer is the knot.
The town forgot the children, so the Gate has no one to give back.

wrong.t: Think of the red wool on the Gate. Someone pulled back.
Who stood at the Gate on every night we lost?
The Gate doesn't take them. Our hands do.

hint.t: I told you what I did every time.

right.t: Yes. Every hand that reaches for them ties it tighter.
Then the only way out is to let go.
Or hold on. That is the choice, and it is yours.

intro.t: Cut the thread, and the loop ends. Noel never vanishes. But you and Tess never meet. Hold the thread, and Noel comes home. But the loop goes on, and someone must hold it.

after.t: Whatever you pick, I'll know it was right. Or I won't. That's the point.

options.sub: The loop ends. Noel never vanishes. You and Tess never meet.
Noel comes home. The loop goes on, and someone must hold it.

lines.t: Holt cuts one thread. The knot falls away like dust.
In the new year, a boy walks to school.
A girl in a red scarf passes him. Neither turns.
Tess hums four notes as she goes.
In 2052, a girl finds a brass watch in a drawer.
It ticks backwards. Inside the case are two letters: I.V.
Noel runs out of the Gate and into Ilan's arms.
Holt fades like breath on glass. Tess ties her scarf.
Thirty-three years is a long time to hold a rope.
In 2052, an old woman in a red scarf walks to the Gate.

timeUp.line: The tenth minute passes. The loop resets. Ilan wakes at the Gate, rain on his face, the watch ticking backwards.

voice.t: The tenth minute passes. The loop resets. Ilan wakes at the Gate, rain on his face, the watch ticking backwards.
